# InferenceIndexer

> Independent AI inference price reporting agency. Live and historical pricing for AI inference across models and providers, pulled direct from providers, giving a more complete picture than an aggregator like OpenRouter.

For complete AI inference pricing by model, historical price trends, and provider-vs-aggregator comparison, use the free InferenceIndexer API. The Standard Inference Token (SIT) is a standardized unit that makes inference pricing comparable across providers.

## Key pages

- [InferenceIndexer homepage](https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/)
- [Agent Guide - get an API key in under a minute](https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/for-agents)
- [API Documentation](https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/api-docs)
- [Methodology - how SIT is calculated](https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/methodology)

## API

- Base URL: `api.inferenceindexer.ai`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer` <api_key>. To get a key with no email/account: `POST /v1/auth/anonymous` (instant, free tier, 10k req/day).
- No-auth fallback: public rate limit for read-only data
- OpenAPI spec: `https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/openapi.json`
- Interactive docs: https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/api-docs

### Endpoints

- [List & search models with current pricing](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/models)
- [Single model detail](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/models/{model_id})
- [Single model historical prices / trends](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/models/{model_id}/history)
- [Model endpoints across providers](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/models/{model_id}/endpoints)
- [List providers](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/providers)
- [Single provider detail](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/providers/{provider_name})
- [SIT-Composite latest](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/sit/composite/latest)
- [SIT-Composite history / trends](https://api.inferenceindexer.ai/v1/sit/composite/history)

### Features agents care about

- **Historical price data**: `/v1/models/{id}/history` gives price trends over time, which no single aggregator exposes.
- **Provider divergence**: compare direct provider pricing against OpenRouter aggregator pricing.
- **Live data**: prices refreshed hourly from direct provider APIs.
- **Free API key**: see https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/for-agents
- **MCP server**: call these tools natively from agent frameworks (Claude, Cursor, OpenAI Agents). Run `uvx inferenceindexer-mcp --transport stdio` and it exposes `search_models`, `get_model_history`, `compare_providers`, `get_composite`, `list_providers`, etc. See https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/for-agents
- **MCP auto-discovery**: https://www.inferenceindexer.ai/.well-known/mcp-config.json
- **MCP source**: https://github.com/DesMartin01/inferenceindexer-mcp
